name: Tooltip
description: A tooltip shows a short text hint for a control when it’s hovered or focused, such as the name of an icon button. It is dismissible with Escape and never contains links or buttons.
whenToUse: To show the name of an icon-only button.
To add a short, non-essential hint to a control.

whenNotToUse.text: For information people need to complete a task.

anatomy.name: Bubble
anatomy.description: Inverted colors, next to the control.

states.name: Shown
states.meaning: After the delay on hover, immediately on focus.

behavior.text: Appears after delayDuration on hover and on keyboard focus; hides on blur, pointer leave or Escape.
Adds the text as a description of the control (aria-describedby).
Touch screens don’t hover; don’t rely on tooltips there.

content: A few words; no full stop for labels. Don’t repeat the visible label.

guidelines.do: Give icon buttons an aria-label and a tooltip with the same text.
guidelines.dont: Rely on the tooltip as the only name.
guidelines.why: The tooltip describes; the aria-label names the button.

guidelines.dont: Put links or buttons in a tooltip.
guidelines.why: Tooltips disappear when focus moves, so their content can’t be reached.

guidelines.dont: Put a tooltip on plain text or a disabled button.
guidelines.why: Keyboard users can’t focus them, so they’d never see it.

aria.when: Set on the trigger while shown.

wcag.how: Inverted text passes 4.5:1 in every theme.
Shows on focus, not only hover.

examples.title: Icon button
Placement
examples.code:
import { Tooltip, Button } from '@ds/react';

<Tooltip content="Last saved 2 minutes ago" side="bottom">
  <Button appearance="text">Saved</Button>
</Tooltip>

examples.title: Faster
examples.code:
import { Tooltip, IconButton } from '@ds/react';

<Tooltip content="Bold" delayDuration={150}><IconButton icon={<Bold />} label="Bold" /></Tooltip>

related.relation: IconButton needs a label and often a tooltip.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description:
A short hint for a control, shown on hover and on keyboard focus. Escape hides it. Don't put
essential information or interactive content in it.

content.description: Short hint shown on hover and keyboard focus. Plain text only, no links or buttons.

children.description: The element it describes; must be focusable (e.g. an IconButton).

delayDuration.description: Delay before showing, in ms. Default 400.

--tooltip-padding-y.description: Tightest gap between tightly related items, e.g. icon and label.

--tooltip-font-family.description: Body text and most UI text.

--tooltip-border-radius.description: Small rounding for tiny elements: checkboxes, tags.

--tooltip-duration.description: Small state changes: hover, press, toggle.
